title: Building 001 multi-observer sketch reconstruction observations
submitted_by: Gottfried Schmidtke / interactive AI team session
summary: Unreconciled observations from ChatGPT, Gemini and Grok while interpreting and reconstructing the same hand sketch. Disagreements are preserved intentionally for curator review.

shared: The 14 m x 14 m extents, 6 m upper-bar depth, 6 m projecting-wing width and derived 8 m projecting-wing depth are stable across interpretations.
The dominant main gable plus lower wing roof is better supported than equal cross-gables.
Plan and perspective together support a canopy with vertical supports in the re-entrant area.
Unresolved openings should not receive invented dimensions in the default reconstruction.
Source evidence, interpretation and realization assumptions must remain distinguishable downstream.
chatgpt: Identified the sketch as partially resolving S11/S12/S14 state rather than requiring a restart at S00.
Recommended cross-view correspondence and explicit realization profiles.
gemini: Read the right-bedroom handwritten leader as 'WARD.'.
Successfully recovered the major footprint, room topology, roof hierarchy and canopy/post concept from the neutral record.
Its construction response showed that labeled assumptions can sound authoritative in prose unless evidence class is kept explicit in the output contract.
grok: Read the same handwritten leader as 'WTRD.' and left it unresolved.
Saw approximately four or five post marks rather than the three-post realization used in one concept profile.
Recommended a source-first evidence ledger, explicit concept build mode, and sidecar provenance for generated geometry.
Suggested allowing multiple plausible proportional realizations rather than one arbitrary default for undimensioned geometry.

candidate_readings: approximately four or five visible marks
preserved_disagreements.recommended_evidence_state: observed existence; approximate/ambiguous count and spacing
